name: Orthogonal
description: Lets agents discover, pay for, and call third-party APIs per use through a capability marketplace spanning more than thirty-five integrated services.

skills.name: Service Discovery
skills.description: Searches a marketplace of callable APIs and returns the schema needed to invoke one.

skills.name: Metered Payments
skills.description: Settles per-call payments to third-party API providers on behalf of the calling agent.

skills.name: Unified Invocation
skills.description: Calls any marketplace service through one endpoint without per-vendor credential setup.
